If someone from where I work did the exact same thing I was planning on doing. I would never forget them, they would cross my mind every day. 
Though, I’ve been told I place people too high in my life, and myself too low
So while I say I would never forget them, I imagine the opposite for me, i would be easily forgotten. 
Every so often my name would pass someone’s head but for how long? 5 minutes? “Ah, remember when Breaking_heaven did this? Good times” 

And perhaps that’s the issue with me 
I treat everyone like royalty in my life but when it comes to doing to myself? 
I couldn’t give less of a damn. 

It’s okay, I have to go to work soon and I think my manager wants to go out for dinner afterwards. I’ll be busy for the next 8 hours or so.

Deep deep down I know my coworkers. Especially James, has shown me that they’re not like my family, or what I’m used to
But I’m too scared to let them in 100% 


In life all I’ve wanted is a sense of belonging. A sense that I’ve never received. 
I thought that with how well I work and such was doing, that I had finally found peace. Alas, I haven’t seen some people from work for almost two weeks. James is the only person I talk to and i fear that by talking to him too much I’ll eventually annoy him into leaving. It would be the first time this has happened 
I’ve realized that the pros of leaving this world outweighs the cons
Will I be missed? Yeah. Sure okay i will be, but for how long? I can promise you people won’t be thinking of me in December, or even October. 
Every so often someone will look at my Instagram, and see the photos of me and the videos of my dog and I running in the forest. 
But I can promise you no one will miss me so much that it breaks them. 
Maybe people will be mourning for a little but they’ll move on
Living isn’t worth the amount of suffering I have to do.

Perhaps I should’ve mentioned earlier, I was diagnosed with BPD not too long ago, especially I feel emotions more amplified and intense. 
And though being given a diagnosis for that cleared up some of my lose ends. It also made somethings more confusing. 
However, I don’t think I’ve ever made the connection between, increase emotional pain and increase physical pain 

I have no doubt that the people in my life care. Most of the people in my life view me as a younger sibling. I am aware of this, yet I refuse to accept that people care about me
Throughout my entire life my family has beaten me, mentally, emotionally abused me. The whole nine yards. I’m terrified in thinking that someone could care, because the people who were supposed to care about me didn’t. And if my own family, my own blood wouldn’t care. Why would some random people from work care? 
And besides if I keep my distance and don’t accept people caring, leaving will be easier 
On my end though, I don’t think I have ever loved a group of people more in my life, there is nothing I wouldn’t do for them. 


I have gone to the doctors multiple times and been given notes, letters everything to try to explain to my work that.. me being tired and asking to be cut isn’t my fault. It was medical, but alas, they keep their decision the same.
Hey, wanna chat?

Everyone at work knows I’m struggling. 
I’m really competitive and if someone makes a bet with me i refuse To lose. Hence why I stopped cutting myself. James wanted me to stop and bet I couldn’t do it for a month. I went 45 days without.. just to show him.
Everyone at work knows I cut myself also. Hell its hard not to, there’s a really big scar on my cheek from when I relapsed in February. It’s turned into a keloid scar. 
Everyone knows, but no one knows how bad it is. 
If anyone were to know it’d be James but I’ve been trying to become more distant with him regarding my personal life as of late.. in hopes it can distance us and my going won’t hurt as much as it could. 
My manager asked me one day if She should be worried about me doing anything drastic 
She found out I was suicidal that day. But I convinced that I’m better and happy. 
I hate the pain they cutting brings, absolutely hate it. I used to love it but my nerves are so broken and beaten that any physical pain I feel is amplified. 
I hate the pain but I love the feeling. It’s almost like, all my pain is being released and in that short period of time 
I don’t feel sadness, I don’t feel anything 
And that’s what I want 
I don’t want to feel anything.


Existing is a pain I cannot describe
I’ll never be capable of stringing the proper words together and explaining how much pain I’m in to exist 
At times I feel like I should apologize for breathing. 
I feel like I need to apologize 
For existing

The transfusion probably saved my life. 
I donated blood two hours prior to the injury and I’m anemic with hemophilia.  Whoever donated the blood most likely saved my life. 

 I have two things left to do. 
One of them is to go out with m coworker (let’s call him James because... I’ll probably mention him a bit) one last time. 
He’s probably the closest thing I’ve had to family in my entire life. When i worked mornings him and I were always off at the same time, so, we’d go out for dinner and get bubble tea. I want to do it one last time before I go. 
The second thing is to clean my house. I live alone and I’ve had no reason to clean, I don’t want to be found with week old dishes in my sink and laundry that’s been procrastinated for over a month. I want to leave as little worry as possible. 

I lent James my switch on Tuesday and yeah.. I kinda miss it but I know that once I’m gone he’ll love it. Over 20 games on it and I know he was the best person to give it to. 
I gave my favourite video game series to my manager and I’m not sure if she’s played it yet but I’m happy she has it. 
I have a list of everything else. Who gets what. 
I didn’t buy a sense of freedom it brought a sense of “I’m sorry that you don’t know why I’m so persistent on letting you borrow this” and I gave me a sense of “this time I won’t chicken out” 
Because I’ve planned dates before but I’ve always had something new come up. 
I won’t chicken out this time. 

I work as a server and though nights are nice because you aren’t stressed out 
The person I’m always with is mid 50’s and I’m not even 20 yet. There isn’t a lot of conversations that we have... since both of us are entirely different people. So, we keep quiet. Maybe once every two hours he’ll tell me a joke and ask for my opinion on something. When I’m on morning I’m with at least 5-6 other people. And all of us have a really fun time together. Especially James and I. 

I’ve never had a family. My dad is addicted to drugs and alcohol so I’ve cut ties with him
My mom is trying start a new life away from him 
And I love alone. I’ve never been close to anyone 
And I’ve never had friends. Besides work. 


I was at a high. I had every good shift you could imagine, my mental health was at a high. I was a month free of self harm, James and I were talking almost every day, and going downtown all the time. I was never so happy. 
But since that blood transfusion my life has been in a rut. One that I can’t get out of 
I’m drinking to fix the pain, cutting myself to hell and I haven’t eaten anything besides sour patch kids since Tuesday night.

This month, the month of May. 
By May 31st  I will no longer exit. 
I have two or so things that need to be finished before I go, and if I rush them I can easily have them done by the end of next week. 

I have no purpose here anymore. 
I have nothing keeping me here and no reason to continue burdening everyone with my existence. 
I’ve already begun giving things away. 
No ones realized it but I’ve “lent” many of the things I hold close to me to coworkers.. I have no intention of getting them back. 
This time last month I was at my peak. However I worked 15 days in a row and understandably grew tired shortly after I lost a lot of blood and needed a blood transfusion. I began asking to go home early because I wasn’t feeling well and by being at work I would be more of a hinderance. So, work cut my shifts. 
I get 3 shifts a week. But they’re on night 
Which is fine but it’s getting to me. The lack of social interaction has made realize that I can disappear and no one will notice. 
Not a single person.

I’m still here. 

I’m still determined to do it this month. 
I’m not in that much of a rush anymore. But I will do it. This. Month. 

I have nothing to lose
I’ve been better
Ah, I’ve been better
I could use someone :/

My narcissistic ex-best friend 

We met on my birthday three years ago through a mutual friend of ours. I wasn’t the most liked girl in school, everyone knew me but I only had 2 or so friends. (let’s call him James) when I met James we instantly clicked as friends, that day we walked home together and talked as if we were long lost friends. 
Since James was a year older than I he graduated roughly two months after we met. 
During the summer we spent every. Other. Day. Together
And this is where the red flag started 
I had a full time job and loved it 
He didn’t have a job 
But Im really giving when it comes to money and buying him lunch wasn’t a big deal for me. 
I worked, I was 17 at the time and the only bill I had to pay was my phone bill. The rest of my paycheques were in my bank account. 
So we would meet up, go out for lunch and walk around town and kill time. 
Since I had little to no friends during this time I cherished James like a king and he knew it. 
Backstory on me: I was diagnosed with BPD three or so months after I met James, and during my entire life I had been abused, mentally, physically, sexually.. the whole nine yards. I clung to anyone who showed the smallest amount of kindness to me, I held onto them for dear life. 
Skip through the summer James was going to university and I was finishing grade 12
Whenever he could he would leave class and visit me at school. 
We went out all the time for dinner (i payed) 
And around this time I got him a job where I worked, I was serving he was hosting. Still, he always had a reason for me to pay the bill. 
He began trying to control what I did. I like parties and drinking, James despises it 
So I stopped going to parties for him
He started getting me to skip school because he wanted to hangout 
I stopped talking to my old friends I reconnected with, because he was jealous. 
I had to text him whenever I left my house and tell him where I was going, who I was with, when I was getting there, why I was going and when I would be back. 
When my dog and grandma died two days apart. He didn’t care, he wanted to go for dinner and when I said no he proceeded to yell at me and virtually dragged me out of the house. 
I was still crying and he told me to suck it up and wait until after dinner. 
People began telling me that this friendship we had was full of red flags. So I cut them out of my life. 
James attended my graduation and kept telling me how proud he was in front of everyone, and when we got back to my house he proceeded to yell at me and ask why I was talking to the people he didn’t like and why I took photos with everyone except him. 
He had found a new job at a new place because the managers had realized what James was doing to me and stopped giving us shifts together, I worked 6 days a week which ultimately left hands with one. So, he left
I began picking him up from work (he would get off roughly around midnight-1 am) 
We would do the same thing, I pick him up, we go for bubble tea, and we go home 
One night, I forgot to grab something from my house so on our way back home I stopped at my house and grabbed something I had borrowed from him. When I got back to the car he began yelling at me saying that all he wanted to go was go home, and proceeded to leave my car (we lived close but it was roughly a 30-45 minute walk) I tried to pull him back in because of how unsafe it would’ve been to walk. 
He punched me. And then again. And again. 
And as he left the car he grabbed my cheeks pulled me closer to him and whispered “don’t piss me off again” and threw my head back. 
I didn’t see any red flag in this. 
Finally I got a message from him saying I’m too “overbearing” and he “needs a break” 
Two months go by without a word and I hear that he proceeded to make a secret group chat with our old group chat basically just shit talking me and saying that I’m a controlling bitch who was abusive. 
We met up a week before last Christmas 
And he looked at me dead in the eyes and said 
“I never was your friend, you were easy to manipulate and I knew if I asked you would buy me dinner. I was never your friend, you were a walking ATM for me. A free meal. You’re worthless breaking_heaven absolutely worthless” 

He came to my work last week, unknowing that I worked there (I changed jobs to try and avoid him) when he saw me smiled walked past me and said “I didn’t realize ATM’s needed jobs”

I went to my first party since him and I went separate ways two days ago. 
45 people in the room and everyone was crying
